# Netlify Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill with read-only visibility into your Netlify account: list sites and inspect recent deploys (state, created at). No deploy, rollback, or env-var commands ship. Uses a Netlify personal access token, kept in Muse's secure vault. Free tier available. Draft: written from Netlify's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
